subject: Urgent: Azure catalog SKU-bundle concession request for OceanTree
messages:
From: Anna Slater <anna.slater@oceantree.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SKU bundle pricing concession for Azure catalog listing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — OceanTree is excited about the SKU bundle in the Azure catalog. Procurement has asked me to submit a formal concession request: they need a stronger entry price to include Redwood in the RFP shortlist. Specifically, they are looking for a 30% list discount on the three-SKU bundle for 12 months to meet internal TCO targets.

Timeline is tight: their board meets on 2027-11-29 and procurement needs final pricing by 2027-11-24 to include in the board package. Can you advise whether Redwood can accommodate a concession and if so what approval route is required?

I've attached a short RFP summary and the HubSpot deal link (Deal 457).

Regards,
Anna Slater
Procurement Manager
OceanTree Inc.
Attachment: OceanTree_RFP_summary.docx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SKU bundle pricing concession for Azure catalog listing

Team — forwarding OceanTree's ask. Quick context: OceanTree is a mid-market customer with an expected first-year ARR of ~$420k if we win the bundle. They are a strategic reference for our retail vertical and would participate in an Azure co-sell workshop. The customer is asking for 30% off list on the three-SKU bundle for 12 months to make the RFP.

My recommendation: consider a split approach — publish at ~22% discount on the marketplace listing (so Azure shows competitive pricing) + a one-time marketplace co-sell credit of $35k to offset the remainder for the customer (applied as a private offer/credit). That preserves some unit economics while giving procurement the headline price they need.

Can Deal Desk (Rishi) and Finance (Laura) confirm if that structure is acceptable and what approvals we need. Ben, can you confirm ARR / usage assumptions and whether we can commit to reference activities? Karthik, please flag any listing constraints with Azure marketplace.

Attachments: Azure_SKU_Bundle_Offer_v3.pdf, margin_calc_OceanTree.xlsx

Thanks,
Soojin
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SKU bundle pricing concession for Azure catalog listing

+1 to Soojin's approach. Customer will commit to a 12-month contract, expected usage skews toward medium token volumes (we're projecting ~2.8M generation tokens/month first 6 months). They also want a 90-day pilot start date. If we push 25% off list and layer a $50k private offer credit, I think we can close faster, but margin impact gets larger.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/457 — I've added updated ARR/usage notes and the proposed quote.

If Finance can support a 22–25% publish concession + managed private offer credit, I'll take point on the DocuSign and buyer communications.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SKU bundle pricing concession for Azure catalog listing

Thanks — a few items I need to sign off:
- Confirmed First-year ARR: ~420000 (per Ben's HubSpot notes)
- Expected gross margin at publish price (22%): see attached margin_calc_OceanTree.xlsx
- Are there any downstream partner rebates/credits from Azure marketplace if we publish the lower price? (Karthik please advise)

We can approve a one-time private offer credit alongside a modest publish concession for strategic reference accounts, but this requires Finance sign-off for the credit amount and a Marketplace Ops (Azure) notification for listing changes. Laura, can you confirm we have budget for a $35–50k credit? If yes, Rishi will prepare an approval memo and carve out the private offer terms.

Rishi/Ben/Soojin — I reviewed the margin calc and the strategic rationale. Finance will approve a one-time concession structured as: publish price reduction of 22% on the three-SKU bundle + a $35,000 private offer credit applied at signing. Conditions: 1) customer commits to 12-month contract; 2) CSM to confirm PoS with product usage milestones; 3) Legal to include a cap on subsequent discounting for 12 months.

Rishi — please finalize the approval memo and include the HubSpot deal id. Ben — once Rishi has memo, please prepare DocuSign with the private offer attachment and loop in procurement. Soojin — please confirm reference commitment and workshop scheduling.

I'll save the DocuSign request template (DocuSign_Request_Link.txt) to the deal folder.
